name: Mikie Sherrill
role: Governor of New Jersey (2026-present); U.S. Representative for NJ-11 (2019-2025)
summary: Sherrill is a Democratic former House member (2019-2025) and Governor of New Jersey since January 2026. A Navy veteran and former prosecutor, she pairs a cost-of-living agenda (utility rate freezes, property tax relief, new solar, storage and nuclear generation) with liberal positions on abortion, guns, unions and marriage equality, and opposition to President Trump's tariffs, immigration enforcement and federal cuts. She supports Ukraine and Israel's security while backing a two-state solution.
